description: Banyan HelpBridge is a European contact-center SaaS provider focused on omni-channel support automation. Evaluating Redwood for a 2-week POC that proves reliable RAG-based agent assist + automated ticket summarization with strict EU data residency and KMS controls.
notes: POC scope: live RAG over Zendesk + Confluence + S3 attachments; citation annotations required in agent UI

Quoted on call: "We need source-level citations and timestamps — agents must see where the answer came from. If knowledge is stale, flag it."
Model preference: prefer quantized 70B chat for quality but need fast 13B fallbacks and automated routing policies during load
Integration needs: tool-calling hooks to CRM for ticket updates, ability to trigger runbooks, and a safe sandbox for code/tool execution

Risk noted by legal: retention policies and deletion guarantees across vector DB + cache; require contractual language
Decision criteria: performance under realistic spike load, security signoff, clear rollback/fallback behaviour, and cost per resolved ticket
Stakeholders: CTO (privacy lead), Head of Customer Ops (product owner), Platform Eng (integration lead)
